motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Tch, it wouldn't be fun if it wasn't a little challenging!

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: The situation isn't good. Commander, let's withdraw...

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: Sorry, I went a little too far...

motions.name: login
motions.line: We meet again, Commander. What's the matter? It's only been a day and you already miss me?

motions.name: login
motions.line: We meet again, Commander. What's the matter? It's only been a day and you already miss me?

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: Don't rely on me too much, Commander. You can do perfectly fine on your own...

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: We're heading out again? Very well.

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: You can't just sit all day, Commander. Fancy a drive with me?

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: Don't get the wrong idea, okay?

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Oh? Do you want something from me, Commander?<>Huh? Are you kidding?! I think of you as a friend, but you...you wanna...<>Not that I hate it, but at least give me...some time to prepare...

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Wanna drive me home after work, Commander? Your driving sure did impress me last time. Show me more tonight.
